metric_definition.laplacian_ratio: personalized / plain variance of the 4-neighbour Laplacian at native resolution; >1 means extra high-frequency energy, which is what doubled edges and streaky hair look like
metric_definition.blown: percentage-point change in pixels above luminance 245
metric_definition.darkline: percent of pixels more than 18 below their own GaussianBlur(2.0), native resolution
